lesson_1.title: Max Finder
lesson_1.task: Implement a function find_max(arr) that iterates through the array and returns the largest numeric value. If the array is empty, return 'Error'. You may assume all elements are comparable numbers.

lesson_1.title: Min Finder
lesson_1.task: Implement a function find_min(arr) that scans the entire array and returns the smallest numeric value. If the array is empty, return 'Error'.

lesson_1.title: Sum Search
lesson_1.task: Implement a function sum_all(arr) that returns the sum of all elements in the array by iterating through each value. If the array is empty, return 0.

lesson_1.title: Count Evens
lesson_1.task: Implement a function count_evens(arr) that counts how many elements in the array are even numbers. Return 0 if no even numbers exist or if the array is empty.

lesson_1.title: First Negative Finder
lesson_1.task: Implement a function first_negative(arr) that scans the array from left to right and returns the first negative number encountered. If no negative number exists or the array is empty, return -1.

lesson_2.title: Target Search
lesson_2.task: Implement a function linear_search(arr, target) that scans the array sequentially and returns the index of the first occurrence of target. If the target is not found or the array is empty, return -1.

lesson_2.title: Count Occurrences
lesson_2.task: Implement a function count_occurrences(arr, x) that iterates through the array and counts how many times x appears. Return 0 if x is not found or the array is empty.

lesson_2.title: Last Occurrence
lesson_2.task: Implement a function last_occurrence(arr, x) that returns the index of the last occurrence of x in the array. If x is not found or the array is empty, return -1.

lesson_2.title: Search in Range
lesson_2.task: Implement a function search_range(arr, x, a, b) that searches for x only within the index range [a, b] inclusive. Return the first index where x is found in that range. If not found or range is invalid, return -1.

lesson_2.title: Multi-Target Search
lesson_2.task: Implement a function multi_search(arr, x, y) that returns True if both x and y exist anywhere in the array. Otherwise return False. If the array is empty, return False.

lesson_3.title: Bubble Sort Ascending
lesson_3.task: Implement a function bubble_sort_asc(arr) that sorts the array in ascending order using the Bubble Sort algorithm by repeatedly swapping adjacent elements if they are in the wrong order.

lesson_3.title: Selection Sort Ascending
lesson_3.task: Implement a function selection_sort_asc(arr) that sorts the array in ascending order using Selection Sort by repeatedly selecting the smallest remaining element and placing it in its correct position.

lesson_3.title: Bubble Sort Descending
lesson_3.task: Implement a function bubble_sort_desc(arr) that sorts the array in descending order using Bubble Sort by swapping adjacent elements when the left element is smaller than the right element.

lesson_3.title: Selection Sort Descending
lesson_3.task: Implement a function selection_sort_desc(arr) that sorts the array in descending order using Selection Sort by repeatedly selecting the largest remaining element and placing it first.

lesson_3.title: Visual Sort Tracking
lesson_3.task: Implement a function sort_passes(arr) that simulates Bubble Sort and returns the number of outer loop passes required to fully sort the array.
